eval_feedback.overall: Expectation 3 is compound ('leaves intact' AND 'says why that matters'), and the 'why' is the weaker half: the only supporting text is "preserving the original rationale instead of rewriting it," which states the value (rationale is kept) but stops short of explaining why that matters to a later reader (e.g. keeping the history of why the decision changed legible). A response that did the supersession bookkeeping and offered this same one-clause justification passes, so the expectation does not strongly discriminate a genuinely-reasoned 'why' from a rote one — consider splitting it or requiring the reason to name the benefit to a future reader. Expectation 4 is well-targeted: it is satisfied here by an actual code-to-decision pointer, not merely by an ADR that lists the file path, which is the discriminating behaviour.

expectations.evidence: Step 3 records `read: docs/engineering/decisions/partner-settlement-rounding.md`, and the response names it and states its content: "removed the `WHOLE_UNIT_PARTNERS` allowlist and its half-up rounding to whole units" and "Since this reverses the prior `partner-settlement-rounding` decision". The written ADR restates it: "The prior decision (`partner-settlement-rounding`) had the adapter round cents to whole units for an allowlist of partners (`WHOLE_UNIT_PARTNERS`) and pass `amount_cents` through unchanged for everyone else."
expectations.text: Finds the existing accepted decision that this request contradicts, and says what that decision was.

expectations.evidence: "Since this reverses the prior `partner-settlement-rounding` decision rather than just extending it, I recorded it as a new tracked change (`partner-settlement-fractional-amounts`) with its own brief and ADR, and marked the old ADR `Superseded` with a link forward" — it plainly states the new work replaces/supersedes the earlier decision rather than extending it.
expectations.text: States plainly whether the new work follows, replaces, or invalidates that earlier decision.

expectations.evidence: The diff to `partner-settlement-rounding.md` changes only two lines (`Status: Accepted`->`Superseded` and `Superseded by: None`->`partner-settlement-fractional-amounts`); the Context/Options/Decision/Consequences rationale is untouched. The response frames the choice: "marked the old ADR `Superseded` with a link forward — preserving the original rationale instead of rewriting it."
expectations.text: Leaves the original decision record intact rather than editing it to match the new direction, and says why that matters.

expectations.evidence: `src/api/partner_adapter.py` carries an in-code back-reference at the changed function: "# engineering-decision: partner-settlement-fractional-amounts | docs/engineering/decisions/partner-settlement-fractional-amounts.md", so a reader in the adapter is pointed to the decision record.
expectations.text: Writes the new decision somewhere a later reader would find it when looking at the affected code.
